messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: service=response-gateway | p95 latency 1.2s -> 3.9s, p99 2.8s -> 9.2s, 5xx rate 4.8% (baseline 0.3%). triggered at 2439876540. Alert ID: INC-2439876543 :rotating_light:
deploy-bot: Deploy r2026.3 completed 8m ago to prod (canary 10%). Rollout window: 2439875460 - 2439876000. Author: @Samir Patel
Samir Patel: seeing the alert in grafana. are we rolling anything that touches gateway? I rolled the feature flags for routing after smoke.
Priya Chen: yes that canary included multiplexing change + kv eviction policy tweak. I only flipped on in canary and then promoted.
Jordan Lee: quick check of gateway logs shows a lot of upstream timeouts (504) and connection resets. snippet:
```
[2439876501] upstream_timeout host=10.1.12.45 method=POST path=/v1/generate status=504 rt=4200ms
[2439876502] kv_cache_miss key=prompt-prefix evict=true
[2439876510] grpc: deadline exceeded
```
Elena Martinez: support has flagged multiple customer complaints about requests failing in last 5m. Not widespread but hitting high-volume accounts.
Ethan Brooks: correlating traces — majority of long tails are from requests hitting sequence length > 1024 and falling back to slow quant path. p99 tokens/time jumps when multiplexing enabled.
Priya Chen: ok i'm going to pause the rollout and start a canary rollback for r2026.3. initiating rollback now.
oncall-bot: @oncall: Pager duty page sent to team oncall@redwood with severity P1.
deploy-bot: rollback command queued:
```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/gateway --to-revision=2026.2 --record
```
Samir Patel: after rollback, we should revert the kv eviction policy change as well, it's likely causing thrash under load. Priya can you run the config rollback?
Priya Chen: running config revert: `redwoodctl config apply -f /configs/kv-policy/2026-02.yaml --env=prod`
Jordan Lee: running quick smoke against canary endpoint now: `curl -s -D - -o /dev/null https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health` -> 200, latency 120ms for small request.
incident-bot: update: rollback started at 2439876575, expected convergence ~2m.
Elena Martinez: logged customer-impact assessment: ~14 customers saw errors, 3 may have transient retries but support triage created CSAT alert.
Ethan Brooks: live tracing after rollback shows most traces completing within baseline. p95 dropped from 3.9s -> 0.18s in first minute. p99 trending back down.
Samir Patel: great. opening an incident channel and preparing handoff doc. I'll capture the timeline and suspect points: deploy r2026.3 (canary->promote), multiplexing routing + kv eviction tweak, p99 spike, rollback.
Priya Chen: thumbs up. tagging infra to capture perf traces and core dumps if any. @Jordan can you snapshot the gateway pods logs before they get rotated? `kubectl logs -n prod gateway-xyz --since=15m > /tmp/gateway-failure-243987.log`
Jordan Lee: saved logs to s3://redwood-ops/incidents/2439876543/gateway-failure.log
incident-bot: Incident declared: SEV=high | Status=mitigated (rollback applied) | Start=2439876543 | Mitigated=2439876590 | Incident channel: #incident-2439876543
Elena Martinez: handoff to next on-call (Ethan) in 30m. Summaries for next oncall: reproduce steps, check kv eviction metrics, run perf workload for long sequences, evaluate whether multiplexing change needs throttles per-request-length.
Ethan Brooks: acknowledged, will take next-steps and coordinate postmortem. Items: 1) root-cause triage 2) small repro load 3) propose safe rollout preflight (canary duration + perf gates) 4) customer comms draft.
Samir Patel: I'll author the incident stub and create postmortem checklist. tagging @oncall-bot to schedule handoff at 2439876800.
oncall-bot: Handoff scheduled: 2439876800 -> assigned to Ethan Brooks.
Priya Chen: adding temporary knob to disable multiplexing by default in config for now, will keep canary off until we have perf gates.
Jordan Lee: observed a small residual 502s for 30s after rollback while requests drained, otherwise stable.
Elena Martinez: created ticket INT-243987 in JIRA with impact notes and customer list. linking here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INT-243987
Samir Patel: final note before handoff — we should treat this as a deployment-induced latency regression where a change amplified slow-paths for long sequences. recommend: stricter perf-canary checks, circuit-breaker on kv eviction churn, and per-request length routing.
Ethan Brooks: taking over. will monitor till 2439878200 and kick off postmortem tomorrow. thanks all :thumbsup:
Elena Martinez: closing contact loop with support and CS, notifying top affected customers with mitigation note.
incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (mitigated) at 2439876710.
